card.title: IPad 10 Backlight not working

claims.statement: iPad 10 no backlight is most often the backlight filter (fuse) under the shield, blown by plugging/unplugging the LCD with the battery connected; an iPhone 6s backlight filter can substitute.
The four backlight pins on the LCD FPC read about 0.503 in diode mode; OL or very different readings suggest the filter, though a normal reading doesn't rule it out.
Also check the two glass backlight diodes (one-way conduction) and smoothing caps (find a short with 1 V / 1 A; a shorted smoothing cap can simply be removed); the PMIC rarely fails.
New LCDs commonly come in bad batches; test several or use a known-good one.

procedure: Open the shield; check filter continuity, diodes and caps.
Replace filter (jumper damaged pads), diodes or remove shorted cap; PMIC last.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Connecting or disconnecting the LCD with the battery attached blows the backlight filter.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
